prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Water, of the Hydrogen Nation — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: a futuristic spa of white curves and soft light
Time of day: daytime indoors — bright, even light filling the room; daylight bouncing softly off pale walls.
Light direction: a pool of light from above, the surroundings dimmer.
Small moment: a clear palm print is wiped into the fogged mirror behind her.
Outfit: a sporty bikini with a crop top and boy-cut bottoms — in deep wine red; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: perched on a ledge or edge.
SUPPORT: she sits on the edge, her weight on her hips.
COMPOSITION: a three-quarter shot from her head to just above the knees; body turned three-quarters toward the camera; head tilted slightly; camera slightly above, looking down at her.
Lens / perspective: 50mm-equivalent natural perspective with balanced proportions and modest depth compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right fingertips rest lightly on her cheek.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand braces on the edge beside her hip.
LEGS: knees together, feet slightly apart.
GAZE: she looks into the camera.
EXPRESSION: one mouth corner lifted higher than the other, lips closed.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — airy, pale and luminous, always rising: translucent layers, upward-drifting hair and hems, a faint pale-blue flame (hydrogen burns almost invisibly), star-light and fusion white, water droplets and mist; it is the lightest element, the fuel of stars and half of every drop of water — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Figure: slender-limbed yet full-busted with rounded hips and a narrow waist — keep this exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.
